The strongest initial niche is:

> **Evidence-tested AI applications, product building, and startup economics for technical founders and hands-on product operators.**

This combines three connected needs:

- Evaluating whether AI applications genuinely work.
- Understanding how to build and operate AI-enabled products.
- Interpreting industry developments through product, technical, and commercial consequences.
criterion_scores.rationale: Explicitly prioritizes a niche combining practical AI applications, industry interpretation, and entrepreneurship.

### Better-resourced option

**Budget:** Approximately US$5,000–15,000 per month.
criterion_scores.rationale: The named higher-resource route explicitly incorporates substantial weekly labor and monthly expenditure as its operating configuration.

criterion_scores.evidence_span:
#### Lean

- Two substantial anchor pieces per month.
- Two short posts per week.
- Newsletter twice per month.
- One live session per month.
- Prioritize screen recordings, simple editing, and written frameworks.

Best when the creator has fewer than eight hours per week.

#### Balanced — recommended

- One anchor per week.
- Two or three derivative posts.
- Weekly concise newsletter.
- Monthly live session.
- One reusable artifact every two weeks.

Best when 10–15 hours per week are available.

#### High-polish

- Two deeply produced anchors per month.
- Original motion graphics and custom diagrams.
- Research support and technical review.
- Multiple platform-native derivatives.
- Quarterly flagship report or documentary case.

Best when there is a team and at least 25 hours per week.
criterion_scores.rationale: Directly compares lean and high-polish routes on weekly labor, staffing, output, and production complexity. The consequential resource difference is explicit, but comparative ROI is not established.

criterion_scores.evidence_span:
### DeepLearning.AI: education-led authority

[DeepLearning.AI](https://www.deeplearning.ai/) [9] represents an education-business model in which recurring editorial communication supports courses and a larger learning ecosystem.

Transferable lesson: free educational material can support a durable education brand when learning outcomes and curriculum are clear.

Risk: this is an institutional model with resources, reputation, and production capacity that a new solo creator should not imitate directly.
criterion_scores.rationale: Acknowledges the education model's value but explicitly downgrades direct imitation because of its institutional resources and production capacity.
